subject: AcuityLabs trial orchestration: success metrics & schedule
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya@acuitylabs.com>, Tom Erickson <terickson@acuitylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-10T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed trial success plan & dates

Hi Maya and Tom — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned heading into the trial.

Summary / Success criteria (as discussed)
- Demonstrate 95% intent classification accuracy on your labeled sample set (50k rows) OR parity with your current baseline for top-3 intent.
- <100ms 95th percentile inference latency for 128-token requests under the expected concurrency profile (approx 8 concurrent workers).
- Ability to index and surface embeddings for 500k customer records with refresh window of 6 hours.

Operational assumptions
- We'll run a 4-week trial (2-week ramp + 2-week validation) with a single model variant initially;
- You will provide a labeled sample CSV and a pull-only S3 bucket for nightly sync;
- Redwood will deploy a private trial instance in us-west and provide read-only observability dashboard access.

Proposed timeline
- Week of Oct 19: kickoff + environment handoff
- Weekly check-ins: Fridays at 9:30am PT
- Final readout: Nov 13 (end of validation week) — results + handoff

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Please confirm success criteria above or list any edits.
2) Confirm kickoff week availability (we're proposing Oct 19 or Oct 26). Maya — you indicated Oct 20 may work; can you confirm? 
3) I'll send a draft SOW and DocuSign link once scope is locked. Marissa, Lauren — looping you in to own technical onboarding and CS cadence.

Attachments: redwood-trial-sow-draft.pdf (draft SOW)

Thanks — happy to hop on a short sync if helpful.

— Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Tom Erickson <terickson@acuitylabs.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@acuitylabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial success plan & dates

Thanks Aditya — good recap. A couple of small edits and confirmations from our side: 

On Fri, Oct 10, 2026 at 3:20 PM Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Summary / Success criteria (as discussed)
> - Demonstrate 95% intent classification accuracy on your labeled sample set (50k rows) OR parity with your current baseline for top-3 intent.
> - <100ms 95th percentile inference latency for 128-token requests under the expected concurrency profile (approx 8 concurrent workers).
> - Ability to index and surface embeddings for 500k customer records with refresh window of 6 hours.

Edits / confirmations:
- The accuracy target is fine but can we scope the evaluation to two separate buckets: (1) customer-facing chat intents (30k rows) and (2) backend routing intents (20k rows)? We'll provide labeled subsets.
- Latency target is acceptable but please include a note for under 200ms cold-start for first-token queries during ramp.
- Yes to 500k embeddings; we'll start with 250k for the ramp window.

Kickoff: Oct 20 works for our engineering lead. Can we do Oct 20 at 10am PT? Also, legal will need the SOW + standard DPA — can you upload the SOW to DocuSign and share the link?

Infra contact: forwarding infra@acuitylabs.com here (they'll respond with access details once SOW is agreed).

Thanks — looking forward to the trial.

— Tom
Director of Product | AcuityLabs
terickson@acuitylabs.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Erickson <terickson@acuitylabs.com>, Maya Patel <maya@acuitylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial success plan & dates

Tom — perfect, thanks for the clarifications. I've incorporated your edits into the scope: we will evaluate on the two labeled buckets and note the cold-start latency expectation.

DocuSign / SOW: attaching the draft SOW (redwood-trial-sow-draft.pdf) and pushing to DocuSign now. Link: https://docusign.com/redwood/ACU-2026-045 (will email once envelope is ready).

Kickoff: Let's lock Oct 20, 10:00am PT for the kickoff call. Marissa — can you reserve 30–45 minutes for a technical kickoff (handoff + environment checklist)? Lauren — can you set up the weekly Friday check-ins starting Oct 23?

Marissa / Lauren — initial owners:
- Marissa: technical onboarding, test dataset ingestion, model config, perf targets
- Lauren: check-in cadence, success metric tracking, final readout coordination

I'll wait for infra@acuitylabs.com to send access details and for legal to sign the SOW.

— Aditya
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Thanks — looping in the technical checklist so we can hit the ground running at kickoff. See short list below and an attached ops checklist (trial-ops-checklist.xlsx).

On Sat, Oct 10, 2026 at 3:20 PM Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Operational assumptions
> - We'll run a 4-week trial (2-week ramp + 2-week validation) with a single model variant initially;

Technical pre-kickoff asks (please provide before Oct 18 if possible):
- Sample dataset: upload or share S3 path to labeled CSVs (training / validation subsets). If >100MB please advise, we'll coordinate secure transfer.
- Infra contact + IP allowlist: public IP(s) we should allow for data pulls and observability callbacks.
- Expected steady-state QPS and typical request size distribution (tokens).
- Any PII/data-retention constraints or fields we should mask during ingestion.
- Preferred auth mechanism for S3 (role-based vs access keys).

Trial config notes (what we'll validate in ramp):
- Model family: Redwood-optimized 7B-ish variant (low-latency config) — we'll confirm exact flavor at kickoff.
- Batching: start conservative (batch size 4–8) and tune for the 95th p95 latency target.
- Monitoring: perf dashboards + sample inference logs; we'll provide log access to your infra team.

Attachments: trial-ops-checklist.xlsx (environment checklist + runbook)

I'll be on the Oct 20 kickoff and will demo the ingestion flow and perf tuning knobs.

— Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123

Thanks all — confirming the plan and owners. Quick replies inline.

On Mon, Oct 12, 2026 at 11:00 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Technical pre-kickoff asks (please provide before Oct 18 if possible):

- Sample dataset: I've uploaded the labeled CSVs to the shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-sample-dataset (contains the two subsets: chat_intents_30k.csv and routing_intents_20k.csv).
- Infra contact / allowlist: Hi Redwood team — I'm Priya on infra (pri@acuitylabs.com). I'll send the IPs and S3 role we want you to use by EOD Oct 14.
- QPS / tokens: Expect peak 12 qps, avg request ~90 tokens.
- PII: We have a hashed-ids column; no free-text PII in the labeled sets. We'll provide the mapping under a separate NDA if required.
- Auth: We'll prefer role-based access for S3; pri@acuitylabs.com will coordinate.

Weekly check-ins: Fridays at 9:30am PT works for us starting Oct 23.

SOW / legal: Tom's legal will review the SOW; please send DocuSign link.

See you on Oct 20 at 10am PT for kickoff.
